entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
Anahera Hakiaha and Danielle Herewini of Whakatāne have created a run club to bring their community together and encourage healthy lifestyles. 

Celebrating their one-year anniversary, this club welcomes individuals of all running and walking abilities, including those who have never run before. The two women are incredibly supportive, always present, and dedicated to helping others. The club is completely free and voluntary, meeting 2-3 times a week with a schedule sent out every Sunday. They also introduce fun challenges to keep things interesting. Their motivation to start the club was simply to get and keep people moving. Beyond physical activity, the club offers a fantastic social experience, fostering connections among its members. 

ASB is thrilled to acknowledge Anahera and Danielle’s incredible initiative as this week’s ASB Good as Gold recipients.
